## Freestyle caveats

<a id="freestyle-lifecycle"></a>

### Sandbox lifecycle

One VM from the default `freestyle/ubuntu` snapshot with `ttlSeconds` expiry; destroy waits until Freestyle no longer returns it.

<a id="freestyle-suspension"></a>

### Native sandbox suspend/resume

Freestyle pause keeps memory; start resumes the same processes.

<a id="freestyle-previewProtected"></a>

### Protected HTTP preview

Not implemented by this adapter.

<a id="freestyle-previewPublic"></a>

### Public HTTP preview

`style.dev` routes per port, published at create or on first lookup.

<a id="freestyle-termination"></a>

### Local-handle process termination

Process-group signals on the detached job.

<a id="freestyle-renewal"></a>

### Configured lifetime renewal

Sets `ttlSeconds` to the VM's age plus the requested window.

<a id="freestyle-reopening"></a>

### Scoped sandbox reopening

References hold the VM id and a key fingerprint, never the key.

<a id="freestyle-execution"></a>

### Execution and captured output

Argv and shell through a quoting `sh` wrapper with base64 output, so bytes survive the text channel; output bounded to 1 MiB.

<a id="freestyle-streaming"></a>

### Process streams and terminals

Detached guest jobs with polled, byte-exact stdout and stderr; PTY terminals over WebSocket.

<a id="freestyle-finiteStdin"></a>

### Finite execution input

Freestyle's `stdin` field, up to 1 MiB.

<a id="freestyle-files"></a>

### Binary files and overwrite

Reads and overwrites up to 8 MiB in one sha256-verified upload; larger files stream through range reads and staged writes.

<a id="freestyle-directories"></a>

### Directory primitives

Copy, move, mkdir, remove, stat, exists and listings through a Python 3 helper; paused VMs serve reads through the native file API.

<a id="freestyle-oci"></a>

### OCI image builds

No OCI images; images are Freestyle snapshots.

<a id="freestyle-network"></a>

### Measured network controls

Blocked (empty firewall), internet, and IPv4 allowlists.

<a id="freestyle-storageComposition"></a>

### Cold snapshot with selected storage

Not implemented by this adapter.

<a id="freestyle-snapshots"></a>

### Snapshot roundtrip

Memory and disk from a running or paused VM; restore boots a new VM that resumes the captured processes.

<a id="freestyle-volumes"></a>

### Volume CRUD

Not implemented by this adapter.

<a id="freestyle-persistence"></a>

### Mounted persistence

Not implemented by this adapter.

## Updating support

Reviewed summaries belong in one results JSON per provider. Generate with provider-qualification/render.ts --profile <profile> --results <results-directory> --output <output-directory>; use --check for drift. Live runs require separate authorization and durable owned cleanup.
